verdict.rationale: Automatic compute placement is a fair question for a deployment and edge platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The pack only documents generic serverless functions and a third-party Turso integration that moves data close to edge functions, which is the reverse direction and not Netlify's own capability. Nothing shows Netlify automatically placing compute near backend data.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
